$comment: Business purpose: Defines the Node-mediated run_command tool contract (forge.run_command.v1) and role permissions so System Engineer and Coder execute project toolchains and archives safely without shell access or direct git calls. Technical description: Validates structured command, args, cwd, and timeout_ms parameters, declares allowed_roles (system_engineer, coder) and forbidden_roles (architecture_manager, sprint_leader, reviewer, subagent), and provides action-filtered branches for node, pnpm, npm, npx, php, zip, and unzip.
title: Forge Node-Mediated run_command Contract (forge.run_command.v1)
description: Structured contract for Node Command & Archive Service execution. Permitted only for system_engineer (project-wide) and coder (ticket scope); forbidden for architecture_manager, sprint_leader, reviewer, and explorer subagents.

command.description: Fixed Node-mediated capability identifier. Direct binary paths, shell interpreters (sh, bash), and direct/indirect git are forbidden.

args.description: Structured argument array passed with shell: false. Path traversal (..), inline child_process execution, and .git/ or .forge/ mutation are rejected.

oneOf.title: node
oneOf.description: Execute Node scripts, syntax checks (--check), node:test suites (--test), or pure inline expressions (-e) using process.execPath with shell: false. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: child_process/spawn/exec/git, paths outside projectRoot, or mutating .git/ or .forge/.

oneOf.title: pnpm
oneOf.description: Execute pnpm project scripts and package operations (run, test, lint, typecheck, build, validate:schemas, install, add, remove, list, outdated, why, exec) with shell: false. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: git, publish, login, logout, --global, dlx, or --dir outside projectRoot.

oneOf.title: npm
oneOf.description: Execute npm project scripts and dependency checks (run, test, install, ci, ls, outdated, pkg get, exec) with shell: false. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: git, publish, login, adduser, owner, token, -g, --global, or --prefix outside projectRoot.

oneOf.title: npx
oneOf.description: Execute local project CLI binaries from node_modules/.bin (enforced with --no-install and shell: false). Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: git, remote URLs/packages, or -c shell execution.

oneOf.title: php
oneOf.description: Execute PHP syntax checks (-l), project scripts, or pure inline evaluation (-r) with shell: false. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: shell_exec/exec/system/passthru/proc_open/git, -S built-in web server, or -c outside projectRoot.

oneOf.title: zip
oneOf.description: Create a .zip archive inside projectRoot from project-relative files or directories through Node Archive Service. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder. Forbidden: paths outside projectRoot or archiving .git/ or .forge/.

oneOf.title: unzip
oneOf.description: List (-l) or extract (-o ... -d <target_dir>) a .zip archive inside projectRoot through Node Archive Service with pre-extraction Zip Slip, symlink, and deadline/AbortSignal propagation. Allowed roles: system_engineer, coder.
